cabot-trail-highlands-loop.title: Cabot Trail Highlands Loop
cabot-trail-highlands-loop.slogan: Atlantic headlands, French Acadian coast and moose country. · out and back
cabot-trail-highlands-loop.story: The Cabot Trail wraps the Cape Breton Highlands: long climbs onto exposed headlands, then drops to fishing villages. French Mountain and MacKenzie Mountain are the gradients worth planning around. Moose are a genuine hazard at dawn and dusk - this is not a road to ride tired in low light.

scenicChapters.title: Cabot Trail
scenicChapters.narrative: 14 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

scenicChapters.title: Cabot Trail
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 8 km this is Cabot Trail, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

scenicChapters.title: Cabot Trail
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 14 km. 435 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.
